hero.title:
One Recording.
Four Systems Updated.
hero.description: Talk for 30 seconds about your day. HABOS detects every intent and routes each one to the right place.

intro: This is not speech-to-text followed by a form fill. This is speech to understanding to multi-system orchestration. The closest analog is a human executive assistant who listens to your rambling update and creates four different items in four different systems — except HABOS does it in under three seconds. The system even understands duration: a two-minute recording mentioning 'meeting' is classified as scheduling. A fifteen-minute recording mentioning 'meeting' is classified as meeting notes.

demo.transcript: “Remind me to follow up with Sarah about the kitchen quote, schedule a site visit next Tuesday at 2pm, we used three boxes of tile from inventory, and tell Mike the permits came through.”

cards.label: Task created
cards.detail: Follow up with Sarah — Kitchen renovation

demo.footer: All from one sentence. Zero app switching.

benefitCards.title: 15 min → 30 sec
benefitCards.body: The morning update that used to mean opening 4 apps and typing into each one? Just talk.

benefitCards.title: Zero missed items
benefitCards.body: Confidence scoring catches low-certainty intents and routes them to an inbox for your review.

benefitCards.title: Works everywhere
benefitCards.body: Record on your phone, watch, or Mac. The Smart Router processes identically on every device.

rows.label: Auto-created
rows.detail: High confidence items go straight to their destination.

rows.label: Inbox review
rows.detail: Medium confidence items wait for you to confirm.

rows.label: Brain dump
rows.detail: Low confidence items are saved as notes. Nothing is lost.

closing.tagline: Other apps let you record voice memos. HABOS understands them.
